title: P6 Activity Release 26 registry-only name reconciliation evidence
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
rule: This artifact records evidence-backed reconciliation candidates only. It does not mutate canonical P6 field identity and does not certify equivalence where ambiguity or type/interchange evidence remains incomplete.

entries.semantic_evidence: Activity.Id is the short ID that uniquely identifies the activity within the project.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 523-525; Export ActivityFieldType includes Id at lines 1084-1090.
entries.blocking_reason: Legacy registry name is not an Oracle ActivityFieldType name; canonical aliasing remains unconfirmed.

entries.semantic_evidence: Activity.Name is the activity name and does not have to be unique.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 643-645; Export ActivityFieldType includes Name at lines 1119-1123.
entries.blocking_reason: Legacy registry name is not an Oracle ActivityFieldType name; preserve candidate-only status.

entries.api_type: integer(int32) for ActivityOwnerUserId; arrays for OwnerIDArray/OwnerNamesArray
entries.semantic_evidence: Oracle exposes the activity owner as ActivityOwnerUserId and also exposes owner ID/name arrays; the generic legacy seed does not identify which representation is canonical.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 1058-1065; Export ActivityFieldType includes ActivityOwnerUserId at lines 961-964 and OwnerIDArray/OwnerNamesArray at lines 1133-1136.
entries.blocking_reason: Multiple official owner representations prevent choosing a canonical alias without interchange/domain semantics.

entries.semantic_evidence: Activity.Status is the current activity status with values Not Started, In Progress, and Completed.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 926-928; Export ActivityFieldType includes Status at lines 1203-1205.
entries.blocking_reason: Legacy registry name is not the official ActivityFieldType name.

entries.semantic_evidence: Activity.Type is the documented activity type with six values including Task Dependent, Resource Dependent, Level of Effort, Start Milestone, Finish Milestone, and WBS Summary.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 1000-1001 and 3381-3389; Export ActivityFieldType includes Type at lines 1224-1227.
entries.blocking_reason: Legacy registry name is not the official ActivityFieldType name.

entries.semantic_evidence: Oracle exposes both the calendar name and the unique object ID of the calendar assigned to the activity.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 346-350; lines 1751-1765; Export ActivityFieldType includes CalendarName/CalendarObjectId at lines 1040-1041.
entries.blocking_reason: Generic legacy Calendar seed does not identify whether it denotes the name, object ID, or a composite domain reference.

entries.semantic_evidence: Oracle documents RemainingEarlyStartDate as the date the remaining work is scheduled to begin; it is scheduler-derived but can be updated manually by the project manager.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 2906-2916; Create/Activity endpoint also documents the scheduler/manual-update behavior.
entries.blocking_reason: Legacy name is not an ActivityFieldType name; exact interchange alias remains to be certified.

entries.semantic_evidence: Oracle exposes separate remaining early and remaining late finish dates; the generic legacy seed does not select between them.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 2906-2914 and 2960-2967; Export ActivityFieldType includes RemainingEarlyFinishDate and RemainingLateFinishDate at lines 1171-1179.
entries.blocking_reason: No direct Oracle ActivityFieldType named RemainingFinishDate exists in the Release 26 inventory.

entries.semantic_evidence: Oracle Activity.LastUpdateUser is the name of the user who last updated the activity.
entries.evidence: Oracle Activity GET lines 592-594; Export ActivityFieldType includes LastUpdateUser at lines 1107-1108.
entries.blocking_reason: Legacy registry name is not the official ActivityFieldType name; preserve candidate-only status.
